products.name: Custom Eyeliner Boxes
products.short: A slim tuck carton for a pencil or pen liner, with room for the shade name on the front.
products.meta: Custom eyeliner boxes for pencil and pen liners. A slim tuck carton sized to the barrel. See the fit and request a quote.
products.description: An eyeliner box has to be narrow enough to look like the pencil it holds and tall enough for the cap. A straight tuck carton does that, folds flat before it is filled, and leaves the front clear for the shade.

images.alt: A slim emerald carton with a gold edge beside a black eyeliner pencil.
An open burgundy gloss carton with a black eyeliner pencil inside.
A cobalt matte eyeliner carton beside a navy pencil with a silver cap.
A coral carton with a black window frame and a black eyeliner pencil.

sections.heading: When an eyeliner box fits
sections.body: Choose this when the product is a pencil liner or a slim pen. The carton stands on a shelf, and both tucks close from the same face so packing is simple. It is not the box for a mascara wand or a bottle.

sections.heading: How this differs from a mascara box
sections.body: Mascara is a taller tube. Eyeliner is a slim barrel. The tuck is the same family, but the proportions change. Send the pencil length and the cap diameter so the carton is not a generic square.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Internal width only needs to clear the barrel and cap. Height is the pencil length plus a little clearance. Do not count the tuck flap as height.

related.note: A taller carton for a mascara tube and wand.
A small carton for a lipstick bullet instead of a pencil.
A wider carton for a cream jar.

faqs.q: Can the front name the shade?
faqs.a: Yes. The tucks sit on one face, so the front panel can carry the shade. Artwork is reviewed with the quote.

faqs.q: Will a liquid liner fit the same carton?
faqs.a: Only if the bottle is as slim as a pencil. A wider bottle needs its own width. Send the component, not a guess.

products.structureText: One sheet of paperboard forms the body, the glue seam, the dust flaps, and both tucks. The tucks enter from the same side. The carton folds flat before it is set up.
products.measurement: Measure the product, then add clearance. Internal length is the front panel, width is the side panel, and height runs from the inside bottom to the opening. Do not include the tuck length in the height.
structuralOptions: Top and bottom tucks from the same panel
Optional hang tab on the top tuck
Optional window on the front panel

products.name: Custom Mascara Boxes
products.short: A tall tuck carton for a mascara tube, with the wand length included in the height.
products.meta: Custom mascara boxes for tubes and wands. A tall tuck carton sized to the component. See it and request a quote.
products.description: A mascara box is tall and narrow. The tube and the wand set the height. A reverse tuck keeps the closure off the face that carries the name.

images.alt: A tall violet gloss carton beside a gold-cap mascara tube and a wand.
An open saffron carton with a black mascara tube standing inside.
A navy mascara carton with a copper edge beside a black tube and wand.
A mint carton with a window and a white mascara tube.

sections.heading: When a mascara box fits
sections.body: Use this for a single mascara tube. The carton is filled by hand and folds flat before that. It is the wrong proportion for a short lipstick or a wide jar.

sections.heading: Tube, not a set
sections.body: A skincare set with several bottles wants a rigid box. One mascara tube wants this carton. If you sell a mascara and a liner together, say so, because that is a set, not this sleeve of board.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Measure the closed tube, including the cap. Internal height must clear that length. Width and depth only need to stop the tube from rattling.

related.note: A slimmer carton for a pencil liner.
A smaller tube carton for gloss.
A taller carton when the product is a pump bottle.

faqs.q: Should the wand fit inside with the cap on?
faqs.a: Yes. Size the carton to the closed product the customer buys, not to the wand alone.

faqs.q: Can two mascaras share one box?
faqs.a: That becomes a set. Send both tubes and ask for a wider carton or a rigid box with an insert.

products.structureText: The body is a tube of paperboard. Dust flaps fold in from the sides and the tuck flap closes over them. Because the tucks are reversed, the top opening and the bottom closure are mirrored.
products.measurement: Use internal length, width, and height. The tuck flap length is extra board beyond the height and should not be counted as internal height.
structuralOptions: Top and bottom tucks from opposite panels

products.name: Custom Nail Polish Boxes
products.short: A rigid box with an insert that holds nail polish bottles upright.
products.meta: Custom nail polish boxes for single bottles or a set of shades. A rigid box with an insert. Request a quote.
products.description: Nail polish tips if the bottle can fall. A rigid box with a fitted insert holds the bottles upright and gives a set of shades one lid.

images.alt: An open magenta rigid box holding coral, gold, nude, and red nail polish bottles.
A closed forest-green rigid box beside teal and silver nail polish bottles.
A black rigid box holding lemon, lilac, white, and cobalt nail polish bottles.
An apricot rigid box holding one amber nail polish bottle with a chrome cap.

sections.heading: When a nail polish box fits
sections.body: Use this for a set of bottles that should stay upright. The lid is hinged and closes on a magnet. A single mini bottle can use a tuck carton instead, and you can say that in the quote if the set is only one shade.

sections.heading: An insert, not a loose bottle
sections.body: The photo shows bottles seated in the box. The insert is part of the request. Without it, glass bottles knock the lid. A foldable gift box will not hold the same weight.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Count the bottles and send one bottle’s height and diameter. The insert cells have to clear the caps and still let the lid close.

related.note: A small carton for one lipstick, not a bottle set.
The same style of rigid set box for bottles and jars.
A rigid box for one fragrance bottle.

faqs.q: Can the insert match the number of shades?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us how many bottles and whether the count can change between orders.

faqs.q: Is the lid removable?
faqs.a: On this structure the lid stays hinged. A lid that lifts off completely is the two-piece lid and base.

products.structureText: The base is a five-sided tray. The lid is hinged along the back edge and carries a front lip, and often side lips, so it sits over the base. The magnet is a closure detail, not a substitute for the board.
products.measurement: Give the internal size of the base. The lid adds height outside the cavity. If an insert is needed, the cradle has to sit inside that cavity and still let the lid close.
structuralOptions: Concealed magnet in the front lip

products.name: Custom Lipstick Boxes
products.short: A small tuck carton sized to a lipstick bullet and cap.
products.meta: Custom lipstick boxes sized to the bullet and cap. A small tuck carton for one lipstick. Request a quote.
products.description: A lipstick box is small. The bullet and the cap set both the height and the width. A tuck carton keeps it light enough for a shade wall.

An open powder-blue carton with a berry lipstick inside.
A charcoal lipstick carton beside a rose-gold lipstick.

sections.heading: When a lipstick box fits
sections.body: Use this for one lipstick. The front can carry the shade. It is not a set box and it is not tall enough for mascara unless you send those dimensions instead.

sections.heading: One bullet, one carton
sections.body: A lip gloss tube is often slimmer and shorter. A lipstick mechanism is wider. They should not share a dieline. If you need a sleeve of three bullets, that is a different request.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Measure the closed lipstick, cap included. Add a little clearance so the mechanism is not crushed. The tuck length is extra board, not internal height.

related.note: A carton for a slim gloss tube.
A carton for a round balm tin.
A rigid set box when you pack several shades together.

faqs.q: Can the shade color show on the box?
faqs.a: The front panel is free for print. The exact color is confirmed when artwork is reviewed, not from the photo.

faqs.q: Will a square lipstick fit?
faqs.a: Send the cross-section. A square mechanism needs a wider internal width than a round bullet.

products.name: Custom Lip Gloss Boxes
products.short: A slim tuck carton for a lip gloss tube and doe-foot applicator.
products.meta: Custom lip gloss boxes for tubes and applicators. A slim tuck carton. See the fit and request a quote.
products.description: Lip gloss is a slim tube with an applicator cap. The carton should match that slimness so the shade wall does not look like it is packing a bottle.

An open lilac carton with a teal lip gloss tube inside.

sections.heading: When a lip gloss box fits
sections.body: Use this for one gloss tube. The reverse tuck leaves a clean front. It is a folding carton, so it ships flat and is set up when you fill it.

sections.heading: Slimmer than lipstick
sections.body: Do not reuse a lipstick dieline. Gloss tubes are usually narrower. A mascara carton is taller. Send the tube you actually sell.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Measure the closed tube from the end of the cap to the base. Width should clear the cap, which is often the widest part.

related.note: A slightly wider carton for a lipstick bullet.
A taller carton for a mascara wand.
A shorter carton for a balm tin.

faqs.q: Does the applicator need extra height?
faqs.a: Size the closed product. The applicator is inside the cap when it is sold.

faqs.q: Can the tube show through the box?
faqs.a: That is a window box. This carton has a solid front. Ask for a window if the gloss should be seen.

products.structureText: The body is a tube of paperboard. Dust flaps fold in from the sides and the tuck flap closes over them. Because the tucks are reversed, the top opening and the bottom closure are mirrored.

products.name: Custom Lip Balm Boxes
products.short: A short tuck carton for a lip balm stick or a round tin.
products.meta: Custom lip balm boxes for sticks and tins. A short tuck carton for one balm. Request a quote.
products.description: A balm stick or a small tin needs a short carton. The box is often the only place the flavor name appears, so the front should stay clear of the tuck.

images.alt: A short butter-yellow carton with a copper edge beside a rose-gold balm tin.
An open slate-blue carton with a white lip balm tin inside.
A raspberry balm carton beside a silver tin.
An olive carton with a window and a copper lip balm tin.

sections.heading: When a lip balm box fits
sections.body: Use this for one stick or one tin. It is a light paperboard carton. A gift set of several tins belongs in a rigid box or a sleeve, not in this single carton.

sections.heading: Shorter than a lipstick carton
sections.body: Balm tins are squat. Lipstick mechanisms are taller. Share which one you pack. A kraft face is a material choice if the balm should look simple.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: For a tin, measure diameter and height. For a stick, measure the closed tube. Add clearance so the lid of the tin still opens if it is packed closed.

related.note: A taller carton for a lipstick bullet.
A kraft tuck carton when the board color should show.
A taller carton for a cream jar.

faqs.q: Can a twist-up balm and a tin share one size?
faqs.a: Not usefully. They have different heights. Pick the component you are packing now.

faqs.q: Is this a food-safe box?
faqs.a: No certification is offered here. Lip balm contact with the board should be confirmed for your formula.

products.meta: Custom perfume boxes for a single fragrance bottle. A rigid lid and a fitted insert. Request a quote.
products.description: A perfume bottle is glass and usually valuable enough that the box is kept. A rigid magnetic lid and a fitted insert hold the bottle so it does not hit the lid.

sections.heading: One bottle, held in place
sections.body: A lotion carton is paperboard and tall. This is a wrapped rigid box. If you also need a shipping carton around it, add a shipping box in the notes. The perfume box is not the mailer.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Send the bottle height, the base size, and the cap height. The insert cavity has to clear the glass and still let the lid close.

uses: Travel sprays in a gift box

related.note: A rigid box for several bottles instead of one.
A smaller rigid box for earrings or a ring.
A folding carton for a pump bottle of lotion.

faqs.q: Can the insert be shaped to the bottle?
faqs.a: Yes. A cradle can follow the base. Send a photo or drawing of the bottle with the quote.

faqs.q: Does the box ship by itself?
faqs.a: This is a presentation box. If it has to travel, plan an outer mailer or shipping carton as well.

products.meta: Custom lotion boxes for pump bottles. A tall tuck carton sized to the bottle and pump. Request a quote.
products.description: A lotion bottle with a pump is tall. The carton has to clear the pump, not only the shoulder of the bottle. A reverse tuck keeps the front free for the product name.

sections.body: Use this for one pump bottle. It folds flat and is filled by hand. A set of a bottle plus a jar wants the skincare set box instead.

sections.heading: Include the pump
sections.body: People under-measure pumps. The internal height starts at the base and ends above the pump. A skincare jar carton is shorter and wider.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Measure the bottle with the pump locked down, the way it ships. Width should clear the bottle, not the label overhang if the label is wider.

related.note: A shorter carton for a cream jar.
A locked base when the bottle is heavy.
A rigid box when the lotion is part of a set.

faqs.q: Should the pump be locked for measuring?
faqs.a: Yes. Measure the bottle as it will be packed, with the pump in its shipping position.

faqs.q: Can the carton be kraft?
faqs.a: A kraft face can be requested. The closure stays a tuck. Say that you want the natural board.

products.description: A cream jar is short and wide compared with a pump bottle. The carton should match the jar, including the lid, so it does not look like a bottle box.

sections.heading: A jar, not a set
sections.body: Several jars in one pack need an insert and usually a rigid box. This carton is for one jar. A lotion pump is taller. Send the jar you have, lid on.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Measure diameter and height with the lid closed. Add clearance so the lid is not forced. Do not include the tuck in the height.

related.note: A taller carton for a pump bottle.
A rigid box for a jar plus other bottles.
A locked base for a heavier jar.

faqs.a: Only if you add its length to the measurement. Say so in the quote if the tool is packed beside the jar.

faqs.q: Will the jar show through?
faqs.a: This carton is solid board. Ask for a window box if the jar should be visible.

products.meta: Custom skincare set boxes for bottles and jars packed together. A rigid magnetic lid and an insert. Request a quote.
products.description: A set needs a box that holds every piece in place and still feels worth opening. A rigid lid on a magnet and a fitted insert do that. A tuck carton does not.

sections.body: Use this when more than one component is packed together: a serum, a cream, a small oil. The lid stays attached. People often keep this box.

sections.heading: Heavier than a carton
sections.body: Single jars and single bottles have their own tuck cartons. This box does not fold flat. If the set also has to ship, add a mailer or a shipping carton around it.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: List every component with its height and diameter. The insert has to clear the tallest cap and still let the lid close.

related.note: A rigid box for one fragrance bottle.
A rigid insert box for polish bottles.
A tuck carton when you only pack one jar.

faqs.q: Can the pieces be different heights?
faqs.a: Yes. The insert can step. Send each component so the tallest one is known before the lid height is set.

faqs.q: Can the inside be a different color?
faqs.a: The wrap and the lining can be specified separately in the notes.

products.name: Custom Bottle Boxes
products.short: A tuck-top carton with a base that locks when the box is opened.
products.meta: Custom bottle boxes with an auto-lock base for heavier jars and bottles. See the base and request a quote.
products.description: A heavy jar or bottle is awkward if someone must fold the bottom on every unit. An auto-lock base is glued in advance and locks when the carton is squared. The top is still a tuck.

sections.heading: When a locked-base bottle box fits
sections.body: Use this when the same bottle is packed often and the base should not be folded by hand. It still ships flat. It is paperboard, not a rigid perfume box.

sections.heading: The base is the difference
sections.body: A straight tuck closes both ends by hand. This one only asks for the top. Choose it for heavier glass. A light sample vial does not need it.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Internal height is the clear opening above the locked base, not through the bottom flaps. Check that the bottle and cap can pass through the top.

related.note: A hand-closed tuck for a lighter pump bottle.
A simple tuck for one cream jar.
An outer corrugated carton if this bottle also has to ship.

faqs.q: Is the bottom glued?
faqs.a: Yes. The lock is glued during converting, then it snaps into place when the carton is opened.

faqs.q: Can the top lock automatically too?
faqs.a: This style is a tuck top. A different top closure has to be described as its own structure.

products.structureText: The bottom flaps are part of the same sheet and are glued so they lock when the tube is opened. The top remains a separate closure, usually a tuck and dust flaps. The carton still ships flat.
products.measurement: Internal height is the clear opening above the locked base, not the depth of the bottom flaps. Check that the product and any insert can pass through the top.

products.meta: Custom lid and base boxes for gifts packed from above. The lid lifts off. See both pieces and request a quote.
products.description: Some gifts are packed from above and presented by lifting the cover away. The lid and the base are two rigid pieces. There is no hinge.

sections.body: Use this when the product is placed down into the base and the lid is a separate cover. Apparel folds, scarves, and flat gift sets sit well here.

sections.heading: The lid comes away
sections.body: A magnetic box keeps the lid attached. This one does not. A drawer slides instead of lifting. Say which opening you want, because they are different structures.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: Quote the internal size of the base, then say how deep the lid should be. The lid needs a small clearance so it can come off.

A rigid box that opens by sliding a drawer.
A lighter cover that folds flat before packing.

faqs.a: It needs a little clearance to lift off. How tight that feels is agreed with the specification.

faqs.q: Can this box fold for storage?
faqs.a: No. Both pieces stay set up. A foldable gift box is the one that collapses.

products.structureText: Each piece is wrapped board. The lid’s inside length and width are larger than the base’s outside by a small clearance so it can lift on and off. That fit is part of the specification.
products.measurement: Quote the internal size of the base. Note how deep the lid should be. A deep lid changes the proportion and the way the box looks when closed.
structuralOptions: Lid depth specified to suit the product

products.meta: Custom drawer boxes for kits and flat gifts. A rigid drawer slides from a sleeve. Request a quote.
products.description: A drawer box reveals the product by pulling, not by lifting a lid. It suits a notebook, a small bottle, or a flat kit that should feel kept.

sections.heading: When a drawer box fits
sections.body: Use this for flat or layered contents. The sleeve and the drawer are wrapped board, so the piece stays assembled. It does not fold flat.

sections.heading: Not a paper sleeve
sections.body: A sleeve and tray is folded paperboard and can ship flat. This drawer is rigid. The motion is similar. The weight in the hand is not.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: State the drawer’s internal length, width, and height. The sleeve is larger than that cavity. The usual opening is on the width.

related.note: A lighter paperboard sleeve and tray.
A rigid gift box arranged as a client kit.
A base you pack from above, with a lid that lifts off.

faqs.q: Can a ribbon pull be added?
faqs.a: A pull can be noted. It is separate from the board and has to be described in the quote.

faqs.q: Can the drawer open from a short side?
faqs.a: The standard opens on the width. Another face has to be requested so the structure can be reviewed.

products.structureText: The sleeve is open at the front. The drawer is a tray that travels inside it. The drawer front can sit flush with the sleeve. A pull, if you want one, should be described in the notes.
products.measurement: The internal drawer cavity is the useful size. The sleeve is larger. State the drawer’s internal length, width, and height. Those numbers are the cavity unless you say otherwise.

sections.heading: When a foldable gift box fits
sections.body: Use this for a shallow gift you want to store flat before packing. The cover hides the present until it opens. A product that should be seen wants a window box instead.

sections.heading: It folds, so it is not rigid
sections.body: A magnetic box stays set up and feels heavier. This one collapses. If the gift has to ship, add a mailer in the notes. This cover is not a shipper.

faqs.q: Will it feel like a magnetic box?
faqs.a: No. It folds, and the board is paperboard. A magnet and a wrapped wall are a different box.

faqs.q: Can it be mailed on its own?
faqs.a: It is a gift box, not a mailer. Plan an outer mailer if it has to travel.

products.structureText: Scores let the side walls fold inward and the cover hinge at the back. A front flap closes the box. It is not held by a magnet unless you ask for that change in the notes.

products.name: Custom Corporate Gift Boxes
products.short: A rigid box for a client kit or a welcome gift people keep.
products.meta: Custom corporate gift boxes for welcome kits and client gifts. A rigid lid over the kit. Request a quote.
products.description: A client gift is a small kit: a notebook, a candle, a card. The box should still feel right after it is opened. A rigid lid does that. The pieces need an insert or tissue so they do not shift.

sections.heading: When a corporate gift box fits
sections.body: Use this for a welcome kit or a client gift that will be handed over or kept on a desk. It is a presentation box. Shipping it is a separate carton if the rigid box should not be the shipper.

sections.heading: A kit people keep
sections.body: A subscription mailer is the shipper and is usually lighter. This box stays set up. A drawer is another way to reveal a kit if you want a pull instead of a lid.

sections.heading: What to send with the quote
sections.body: List each item in the kit with its size. The tallest item sets the internal height. Tissue and a card count.

faqs.q: Can our name go on the lid?
faqs.a: The lid is a print surface. Send the artwork with the quote. The photo does not show a logo.

faqs.q: Can the mix of items change?
faqs.a: The insert is cut for the mix you specify. A different mix later may not fit the same insert.

products.structureText: The base is a five-sided tray. The lid is hinged along the back edge and carries a front lip, and often side lips, so it sits over the base. The magnet is a closure detail, not a substitute for the board.
products.measurement: Give the internal size of the base. The lid adds height outside the cavity. If an insert is needed, the cradle has to sit inside that cavity and still let the lid close.
